svg.title: Executing an ADG: statuses over time
svg.desc: The status life cycle (staged, enqueued, finished) and five snapshots of the example ADG being dispatched, with each robot's command queue and the rule that let each action through.

g.text: Enqueue rule: the previous action of the same robot (Type 1) is enqueued or finished, AND every action of another robot it depends on (Type 2) is finished.

g.text: Enqueue rule from Hönig et al., RA-L 2019. The ActionNode status names are the closest fields in interfaces/msg/ActionNode.msg; how the dispatcher maps them is not in the snapshots.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Executing an ADG: statuses over time

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The dispatcher sends an action when its rule holds; the robot runs its queue in order and reports each completion; each report may release more actions.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
